attributes.name: head meta tag set
attributes.definition: Which metadata tags are declared in the document head.

values.definition: Charset, viewport and description meta tags all present.
Charset and description present, with no viewport tag mentioned.
Only a meta description is mentioned.

attributes.name: head metadata extensiveness
attributes.definition: How much metadata the head carries beyond the basics, such as verification, cache or social tags.

values.definition: Only basic tags, with no verification, cache or extra metadata.
Standard basic tags, with no claim of minimalism or extras.
Many additional tags such as social, verification or cache metadata.

attributes.name: script-free markup
attributes.definition: Whether the page markup is free of scripts.

values.definition: Markup is described as having no scripts.
